tagline: Naive persistence: a fresh-context bash loop.
keyFeatures: Stateless execution — a fresh context each iteration
One task per loop: read specs → implement → validate → commit → exit
Git + files as the memory layer (no LLM context retention)
Avoids the 'Dumb Zone' past 60–70% context capacity
Pairs with any SDD planner (OpenSpec, Spec-Kit)
limitations: Not a planning tool — needs specs from another source
Requires well-structured specs to avoid thrashing
No UI or dashboard — purely terminal-based
Wasteful when tasks repeatedly fail (a full fresh context each retry)
